source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: The LORD of heav’n confess,
text.normalized: The LORD of heav’n confess,
text.reading: The LORD of heav’n confess,

text.diplomatic: On high his glory raise.
text.normalized: On high his glory raise.
text.reading: On high his glory raise.

text.diplomatic: Him let all angels bless,
text.normalized: Him let all angels bless,
text.reading: Him let all angels bless,

text.diplomatic: Him all his armies praise.
text.normalized: Him all his armies praise.
text.reading: Him all his armies praise.

text.diplomatic: Him glorify sun, moon, and stars;
text.normalized: Him glorify sun, moon, and stars;
text.reading: Him glorify sun, moon, and stars;

text.diplomatic: Ye higher spheres, and cloudy sky.
text.normalized: Ye higher spheres, and cloudy sky.
text.reading: Ye higher spheres, and cloudy sky.

text.diplomatic: From GOD your beings are,
text.normalized: From GOD your beings are,
text.reading: From GOD your beings are,

text.diplomatic: Him therefore famous make;
text.normalized: Him therefore famous make;
text.reading: Him therefore famous make;

text.diplomatic: You all created were,
text.normalized: You all created were,
text.reading: You all created were,

text.diplomatic: When he the word but spake.
text.normalized: When he the word but spake.
text.reading: When he the word but spake.

text.diplomatic: And from that place, where fixed you be
text.normalized: And from that place, where fixed you be
text.reading: And from that place, where fixed you be

text.diplomatic: By his decree, you cannot pass.
text.normalized: By his decree, you cannot pass.
text.reading: By his decree, you cannot pass.

text.diplomatic: Praise GOD from earth below,
text.normalized: Praise GOD from earth below,
text.reading: Praise GOD from earth below,

text.diplomatic: Ye dragons, and ye deeps:
text.normalized: Ye dragons, and ye deeps:
text.reading: Ye dragons, and ye deeps:

text.diplomatic: Fire, hail, clouds, wind, and snow,
text.normalized: Fire, hail, clouds, wind, and snow,
text.reading: Fire, hail, clouds, wind, and snow,

text.diplomatic: Whom in command he keeps.
text.normalized: Whom in command he keeps.
text.reading: Whom in command he keeps.

text.diplomatic: Praise ye his name, hills great and small,
text.normalized: Praise ye his name, hills great and small,
text.reading: Praise ye his name, hills great and small,

text.diplomatic: Trees low and tall; beasts wild and tame;
text.normalized: Trees low and tall; beasts wild and tame;
text.reading: Trees low and tall; beasts wild and tame;

text.diplomatic: All things that creep or fly.
text.normalized: All things that creep or fly.
text.reading: All things that creep or fly.

text.diplomatic: Ye kings, ye vulgar throng,
text.normalized: Ye kings, ye vulgar throng,
text.reading: Ye kings, ye vulgar throng,

text.diplomatic: All princes mean or high;
text.normalized: All princes mean or high;
text.reading: All princes mean or high;

text.diplomatic: Both men and virgins young,
text.normalized: Both men and virgins young,
text.reading: Both men and virgins young,

text.diplomatic: Ev’n young and old, exalt his name;
text.normalized: Ev’n young and old, exalt his name;
text.reading: Ev’n young and old, exalt his name;

text.diplomatic: For much his fame should be extolled.
text.normalized: For much his fame should be extolled.
text.reading: For much his fame should be extolled.

text.diplomatic: O let GOD’s name be praised
text.normalized: O let GOD’s name be praised
text.reading: O let GOD’s name be praised

text.diplomatic: Above both earth and sky;
text.normalized: Above both earth and sky;
text.reading: Above both earth and sky;

text.diplomatic: For he his saints hath raised,
text.normalized: For he his saints hath raised,
text.reading: For he his saints hath raised,

text.diplomatic: And set their horn on high;
text.normalized: And set their horn on high;
text.reading: And set their horn on high;

text.diplomatic: Ev’n those that be of Isr’el’s race,
text.normalized: Ev’n those that be of Isr’el’s race,
text.reading: Ev’n those that be of Isr’el’s race,

text.diplomatic: Near to his grace.  The LORD praise ye.
text.normalized: Near to his grace. The LORD praise ye.
text.reading: Near to his grace. The LORD praise ye.
